doc: Event script for Donny's hideout in the underground water channel of dungeon 1 (d01e01), the town area at the channel entrance. It plays the story 7 arrival scene where Max and Donny escape Flotsam's Circus Troupe, handles talking to Donny (including Max deciding to leave town and Donny giving him the Classic Gun and Help Receiver), the exit back to Palm Brinks and the entrance to the dungeon floors.
